info.title: Mootz event collection eligibility and voucher API

get.summary: Read public collection mapping and live authoritative chain eligibility for current wallet
get.description: Requires provisioned account and active wallet. Reads chain balance, claimed flag, cap, supply and issuer role. Event tag or Meet does not grant eligibility. RPC failure is 503; local voucher records do not prove ownership. No metadata URI is fetched by the API.

200.description: Collection details, eligibility, cap, totalSupply, remaining, balance (decimal strings) and claimed flag

503.description: Chain unavailable or mapping/domain/contract state invalid

post.summary: Issue recipient-bound canonical EIP-712 Claim authorization without submitting a transaction
post.description: Derives recipient from verified wallet, requires organizer check-in and live chain role/supply/ownership checks. Server clock window; deadline min(now+120 seconds, claim end), rounded down. Same account/clientRequestId retries return identical unexpired voucher. Expired same-key retry is 410; another key during active authorization is 409 CLAIM_PENDING. Successful voucher is authorization, never proof of mint or ownership. Separate direct transaction/relay required; supply can change before execution. Client fields besides clientRequestId are rejected.

200.description: Canonical domain, types, serialized Claim, signature and expiry

400.description: Invalid UUID or unexpected body property

403.description: Provisioning, verified wallet or organizer check-in required

409.description: Already owned, sold out, not open, pending authorization or reused key with changed mapping/recipient/issuer

503.description: Chain unavailable, missing issuer signing configuration, role missing or signer mismatch
